verdict: WhatConverts: Choose WhatConverts when lead and call attribution (not social or email) is the primary marketing measurement job. Scores use the marketing-editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Call + form + chat attribution in one product
Strong specialty fit for lead-gen marketers
weaknesses: Weak on social/campaign content criteria by design
bestFor: Agencies and local marketers needing call/form attribution
PPC teams proving which campaigns drive phone leads
notIdealFor: Teams needing social scheduling or listening
tradeoffs: Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth
Published entry price vs contact/profile/mention upgrade pressure
Marketing automation / email depth vs pure ESP peers
recommendation: Choose WhatConverts when lead and call attribution (not social or email) is the primary marketing measurement job. Compare CallRail-class trackers for alternate call tracking, Google Analytics for web-only attribution, and full MAPs when nurture automation is the job.
